messages:
ria: quick heads-up  we need a concise export lifecycle for SIEM data for upcoming audit. main asks: who can start exports, how long they live, and emergency read flow.
ben: +1. current problem: too many teams can push exports. propose a dedicated role exports.request that only allowed teams get. controller uses ephemeral SA to do actual export.
olga: agree. propose default lifecycle: 14d hot -> 90d warm -> archive 7y for regulated customers. non-reg customers default to 365d cold. hold flag from IR/legal prevents deletion.
tom: unwrap/forward to Splunk: we can't ask downstream to unwrap. design an unwrap-proxy in prod VPC that does KMS.decrypt, logs to audit, and forwards plaintext. require mTLS + short-lived certs.
ria: emergency access? sometimes IR needs immediate access during incidents. my thought: orchestrator can issue a one-time signed URL for a specific object, 15m max, only after 2-person approval recorded in ticket system. all actions logged.
ben: minimal IAM sketch for ephemeral SA: roles/exports.runner with permissions: iam.serviceAccounts.actAs (limited), storage.objects.get/create, kms.decrypt (scoped to exports keyring). no broad logs:read.
olga: note from compliance: creating service accounts with kms:Decrypt triggers CMP-7 review. submit infra-exception if broader scope needed.
security-bot: [alert] CMP-7: kms.decrypt on service accounts requires review. Template: https://redwood.internal/compliance/cmp7.
tom: fallback if unwrap-proxy unavailable: cross-region proxy attempt, then signed-URL fallback with 2-approver flow. signed URL generation rotates envelope key and records rewrap event.
ria: retention of audit for unwrapping: keep unwrap/audit logs in Splunk index for 90d, archive full logs for 2y. add rewrap operations to audit trail.
ben: include these in RFC: IAM snippets, unwrap-proxy DR runbook, emergency 2-person approved signed-URL flow, audit retention windows, and cost estimates for tiering.
olga: I'll add regulatory notes for finance customers (default 7y archive).
ria: I'll draft RFC and attach diagrams showing audit bifurcation: Splunk (90d index) + long-term bucket (2y) + KMS audit trail. ping @ben @olga @tom when ready :white_check_mark:
